title: User Authentication - Successful Login
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with valid credentials and access the dashboard via protected routes.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Submit the login form.
Verify that user is redirected to the dashboard and protected routes are accessible.

title: User Authentication - Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that the login process fails when invalid credentials are provided with appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username/email or password.
Submit the login form.
Verify that login is denied and a proper error message is displayed.

title: Session Management and Logout
description: Verify that user sessions are maintained after login and users can successfully log out, invalidating the session.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials.
Confirm the session is active and persists on page reload.
Perform logout action.
Verify the session is terminated and protected routes are not accessible.

title: Shipment Creation - Valid Data
description: Verify that users can create shipments with valid consignee and shipment details successfully.

steps.description: Login and navigate to shipment creation page.
Input all required fields with valid shipment and consignee data.
Submit the shipment creation form.
Verify shipment is created successfully and visible in shipment list.

title: Shipment Creation - Missing Required Fields
description: Verify shipment creation fails with appropriate validation errors when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment creation page.
Fill shipment form omitting required fields such as consignee or shipment details.
Attempt to submit the form.
Confirm validation errors prevent shipment creation and error messages are displayed.

title: Shipment Update and Cancellation
description: Verify users can update shipment details and successfully cancel shipments before dispatch.

steps.description: Create a shipment or select an existing active shipment.
Modify shipment details and save changes.
Verify updated details are reflected accurately.
Cancel the shipment.
Verify shipment status is set to canceled and no further updates allowed.

title: Shipment Search and Bulk Operations
description: Verify shipment search functionality with filters and the ability to perform bulk operations such as bulk updates or cancellations.

steps.description: Navigate to shipments list page.
Perform searches using filters like shipment status, date range, and consignee name.
Confirm search results match the applied filters.
Select multiple shipments and perform a bulk operation (e.g., bulk cancel or update).
Verify the bulk operation is applied successfully to the selected shipments.

title: Manifest Management Workflow
description: Verify the complete manifest lifecycle including creation, locking shipments, dispatch, arrival logging, and marking manifests as complete.

steps.description: Create a new manifest and add shipments to it.
Verify shipments are correctly assigned and manifest is in 'created' state.
Lock the manifest to prevent changes to shipment assignments.
Confirm manifest status reflects 'locked' and no further edits allowed to shipments.
Dispatch the manifest and log arrival events.
Verify manifest status updates correctly to 'dispatched' and arrival logs are recorded.
Mark the manifest as complete.
Confirm manifest is marked complete and closed for further operations.

title: Customer Management CRUD and Autocomplete Search
description: Verify that users can perform full CRUD operations on customers and use autocomplete search effectively.

steps.description: Navigate to customer management page.
Create a new customer with valid details.
Verify customer is added successfully and visible in the customer list.
Use the search input to type partial customer names/emails and observe autocomplete suggestions.
Autocomplete returns relevant customer matches promptly.
Select a customer and update information.
Verify updates are saved and displayed correctly.
Delete a customer and confirm deletion.
Verify the customer is removed from the system and no longer searchable.

title: Invoice Management - Creation and PDF Generation
description: Verify invoices can be created from shipment or customer order details, viewed correctly, and PDF invoices generated according to enterprise standards.

steps.description: Create an invoice based on a specific shipment or customer order data.
Invoice is created with correct details and status set appropriately.
View the invoice details page.
Verify all data including taxes (IATA, FIATA, GST) and totals are accurate.
Trigger PDF generation of the invoice.
Confirm that PDF is generated, downloadable, conforms to specified standards, and is printable.

title: Invoice Status Workflow and Notifications
description: Verify that invoice status updates are handled correctly and multi-channel notifications (email, SMS, WhatsApp) are sent with audit logs.

steps.description: Update invoice status to sent, paid, or overdue.
Verify status transitions follow defined workflows and restrictions.
Send notifications via email, SMS, and WhatsApp regarding invoice events.
Confirm messages are sent successfully and logged in audit records.

title: Payment Processing with Razorpay Integration
description: Verify payment process initiates correctly, payments are captured via Razorpay, and webhook events update payment status accurately including error scenarios.

steps.description: Initiate payment for an invoice using Razorpay integration.
Payment request is sent and Razorpay UI or API responds with payment options.
Complete payment successfully through Razorpay.
Verify payment status updates to 'paid' in the system.
Simulate Razorpay webhook calls with successful and failed payment events.
Verify webhook validation, payment status updates, and error handling are processed correctly.

title: Real-Time Shipment Tracking Public Page
description: Verify that public tracking pages display real-time and accurate shipment status and event timeline when valid shipment references are entered.

steps.description: Navigate to public shipment tracking page.
Enter a valid shipment reference number.
Shipment status and event timeline information are displayed and synchronized with backend updates.
Enter an invalid or non-existent shipment reference.
Verify appropriate error message or no data found response is shown.

title: Warehouse Inventory Management - Stock Adjustments
description: Verify the ability to add, update, and adjust warehouse inventory counts with correct reflecting of changes in inventory status.

steps.description: Navigate to warehouse inventory management page.
Add new inventory items with valid details.
New inventory records appear with correct data.
Adjust inventory counts for existing items.
Verify updated counts are correctly saved and displayed.

title: Dashboard Analytics Rendering and Data Accuracy
description: Verify dashboard overview cards, charts, and mission control panels render correctly and display data consistent with the underlying business metrics.

steps.description: Login as an administrator and navigate to the dashboard analytics page.
Overview cards display key metrics as expected.
Charts visualize data trends accurately.
Mission control UI components update dynamically and reflect operational statuses.

title: API Endpoint Input Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify all RESTful API endpoints validate inputs using Zod schemas and return graceful, standardized error responses on invalid input.

steps.description: Send API requests to shipment, manifest, customer, invoice, and payment endpoints with invalid or malformed data.
API responds with validation errors following standardized ActionResult formats.
Send valid requests and verify normal operation responses.
No unexpected errors occur and data is processed correctly.

title: Security - RLS Policy Enforcement and Cross-Tenant Access Prevention
description: Verify that Row-Level Security (RLS) enforces scoping by organization and prevents cross-tenant data access.

steps.description: Login as a user from organization A and attempt to access data owned by organization B via UI and API calls.
Access to organization B's data is denied and data is not leaked.
Validate log entries and audit trails for attempted unauthorized access.
All authorization failures are recorded appropriately.

title: Performance - Page Load and Server Startup Times
description: Verify system meets performance targets including sub-2 second page loads, optimized bundle sizes, and server startup under 1 second.

steps.description: Measure page load times for dashboard, shipment management, and tracking pages.
Page loads complete in under 2 seconds consistently.
Analyze bundle sizes of client-side bundles.
Bundle sizes remain optimized as per targets.
Start server instance and measure startup time.
Server starts up under 1 second.

title: Security Utilities - Headers, CORS, and Environment Validation
description: Verify that all security headers are correctly applied, CORS policies enforce allowed origins, and environment variables are validated on startup.

steps.description: Inspect HTTP response headers for security-related headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.).
All required security headers are present and correctly set.
Send requests from allowed and disallowed origins to verify CORS policy enforcement.
Requests from disallowed origins are rejected appropriately.
Start application with missing or invalid environment variables.
Application fails startup with clear validation errors preventing runtime misconfiguration.

title: Deployment Readiness - Database Migrations and Lint Reports
description: Verify successful database migrations and zero critical linting warnings before deployment.

steps.description: Run database migration scripts on a fresh environment.
Migrations complete successfully with expected schema changes.
Run linting tools across the entire codebase.
No critical warnings or errors are reported.
